import java.io.BufferedReader;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;
import java.util.StringTokenizer;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int btcAmount = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int[] btcCosts = new int[100];
        int even = 0, odd = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            int left = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            if (left % 2 == 0) even++;
            else odd++;
            if (even == odd && i != n - 1) {
                int right = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
                i++;
                int btcCost = Math.abs(left - right);
                btcCosts[btcCost] += 1;
                even = 0;
                odd = 0;
            }
        }
        int sawedAmount = 0;
        int currentBTCCost = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < btcCosts[i]; j++) {
                currentBTCCost += i;
                if (currentBTCCost <= btcAmount) {
                    sawedAmount++;
                } else break;
            }
        }
        System.out.println(sawedAmount);
    }
}

import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {

    private static int[] btcCosts = new int[100];
    private static int n, btcAmount;
    private static int even = 0, odd = 0;
    private static int sawedAmount = 0;
    private static int currentBTCCost = 0;

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        n = sc.nextInt();
        btcAmount = sc.nextInt();
        process(0);
        for (int i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < btcCosts[i]; j++) {
                currentBTCCost += i;
                if (currentBTCCost <= btcAmount) {
                    sawedAmount++;
                } else break;
            }
        }
        System.out.println(sawedAmount);
    }

    private static void process(int i) {
        if (i >= n) return;
        int left = sc.nextInt();
        if (left % 2 == 0) even++;
        else odd++;
        if (even == odd && i != n - 1) {
            int right = sc.nextInt();
            int btcCost = Math.abs(left - right);
            btcCosts[btcCost] += 1;
            even = 0;
            odd = 0;
            process(i + 2);
        } else {
            process(i + 1);
        }
    }
}
